thm-linear-logic-embedding — Intuitionistic Embedding

[Hypothesis]

  • 使用 72-df-linear-logic 的 \(P\)、LL语法、否定、\(\multimap\) 与单侧 \(\vdash_{LL}\)。\(p\) 遍历 \(P\)；以下直觉主义连接词为与LL标签区分的自由树构造。\(\Gamma\) 是有限公式集合，\(A,B,C\) 遍历 \(\mathcal F_I\)。\(U_I=\{\langle\Gamma,A\rangle:\Gamma\subseteq\mathcal F_I,|\Gamma|<\omega,A\in\mathcal F_I\}\)，分数写 \(\Gamma\vdash A\) 编码该有序对。
  • \(\operatorname{Cl}\) 见 72-df-types-inference-closure。以下明确限定完整命题直觉主义逻辑；没有一阶量词或额外非逻辑公理。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

Γ^diamond明确编码左侧!假设的线性否定，故不再混用双侧与单侧序列。三种命题连接词及真、假常量均给出翻译。此为源书Appendix B.2的直觉主义嵌入；反向保真依赖无cut证明或相应语义论证，未将前向规则模拟当作完整反向证明。

links.excerpt: $\operatorname{Cl}$ 见 [[72-df-types-inference-closure]]。以下明确限定完整命题直觉主义逻辑；没有一阶量词或额外非逻辑公理。

math.tex:
\begin{aligned}
I_0&:=P\cup\{\bot_I,\top_I\},\quad I_{n+1}:=I_n\cup\{A\land_I B,A\lor_I B,A\to_I B:A,B\in I_n\},\quad\mathcal F_I:=\bigcup_nI_n,\\
R_I:=&\left\{\frac{}{\Gamma\vdash A}:A\in\Gamma\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{}{\Gamma\vdash\top_I}\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash\bot_I}{\Gamma\vdash A}\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\cup\{A\}\vdash B}{\Gamma\vdash A\to_I B},\quad\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\to_I B\quad\Gamma\vdash A}{\Gamma\vdash B}\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\quad\Gamma\vdash B}{\Gamma\vdash A\land_I B},\quad\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\land_I B}{\Gamma\vdash C}:C\in\{A,B\}\right\}\\
&\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash C}{\Gamma\vdash A\lor_I B}:C\in\{A,B\}\right\}\cup\left\{\frac{\Gamma\vdash A\lor_I B\quad\Gamma\cup\{A\}\vdash C\quad\Gamma\cup\{B\}\vdash C}{\Gamma\vdash C}\right\},\\
\Gamma\vdash_I A&:\Longleftrightarrow\langle\Gamma,A\rangle\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_I}(R_I),\\
p^\circ&:=p^+,\quad\bot_I^\circ:=\mathbf0,\quad\top_I^\circ:=\top,\\
(A\to_I B)^\circ&:=!A^\circ\multimap B^\circ,\quad(A\land_I B)^\circ:=A^\circ\mathbin{\&}B^\circ,\quad(A\lor_I B)^\circ:=!A^\circ\oplus!B^\circ,\\
\Gamma^\diamond&:=\sum_{A\in\Gamma}[?(A^\circ)^\perp],\\
\Gamma\vdash_I A&\ \longleftrightarrow\ \vdash_{LL}(\Gamma^\diamond+[A^\circ]).
\end{aligned}
